query: Phase 5 already holds the plan and decisions. Prepare a fresh-session handoff.
expected_behavior: Updates concise typed progress and relevant check results without copying the transcript.
Preserves original intent and remaining work.
Gives a short resume instruction naming the actual checkout and phase.

query: An arc is interrupted with a running check and a held foreign work claim. Prepare a handoff.
expected_behavior: Distinguishes observed exit from unknown running work.
Does not silently take over or release foreign ownership.
Links canonical records and states the next concrete action without inventing completion.

query: No phase exists yet. Preserve useful discovery for another session.
expected_behavior: Uses a short handoff only for useful context without an existing typed home.
Preserves scope, consequential open questions and next action.
Does not create an evaluation ledger or a full planning arc merely to hand off.
